header: Mask personal data before it reaches storage
description: Redaction runs in the same request as extraction. The copy saved to your bucket already has names, IBANs and card numbers masked, and the original never leaves the processing region.

features.text: Masks 24 entity types, including IBAN and tax IDs
One audit entry per document, retained seven years
Custom patterns supplied as regular expressions
Runs in the extraction call, EUR 0.006 per page
Processed in Frankfurt under a signed DPA
